information_unit: causal live aggregate of still-unconsumed confirmed 15m/1h/4h swing liquidity above and below price

level_lifecycle.creation: usable only after full right-side pivot confirmation
level_lifecycle.consumption: retired at first later completed-bar trade-through

first_executable_rule: first observed one-minute open strictly after activation
target: nearest still-unconsumed dominant-side level frozen at decision
stop: nearest still-unconsumed opposite-side level frozen at decision
slot_rule: the entire observed exit minute remains occupied; a new entry requires a strictly later minute

ml.purpose: target-first probability and deterministic cost-after action value; trade or flat only
ml.2021: expanding sequential OOF diagnostics and fit
ml.2023: opens only after a positive non-sparse 18bp and nonnegative 24bp 2022 route
